name: mRemoteNG
description: Weekly self-update; verifies Authenticode thumbprint + SHA512 before auto-launch (both from unsigned manifest).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: mRemoteNG's Windows updater downloads a channel-described MSI, requires Authenticode verification against the metadata thumbprint, and compares the file's SHA-512 before accepting it. The reviewed source does not establish authentication of the channel metadata or a weekly schedule.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; metadata signing/authentication, framework/platform installer behavior, weekly scheduling, and auto-launch behavior were not independently established.

original_evidence.text: | mRemoteNG | github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG | .NET (C#, WinForms) | Y | Y (startup check); download/install requires a user click, then executes automatically on app exit | Y | https (default `UpdateAddress=https://mremoteng.org/`; manifest/changelog/installer URLs observed use `https://github.com/...` and `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/...`) — standard `HttpClient`, no custom cert-validation bypass found | N (manifest is a plain `key: value` text file, e.g. `Version/dURL/clURL/CertificateThumbprint/Checksum` — no digital signature on the manifest itself; trust relies solely on TLS to `mremoteng.org`) | Y — dual check before install: (1) Windows Authenticode signature verify with pinned thumbprint (2) SHA-512 checksum compare | Authenticode thumbprint + SHA-512 checksum are both supplied by the (HTTPS-delivered, unsigned) manifest itself — not hardcoded/pinned in the app binary | `mRemoteNG/App/Checks/AppUpdater.cs:166-189` (Authenticode `RequireThumbprintMatch`/`ThumbprintToMatch` then `SHA512` compare, throws on mismatch); `mRemoteNG/App/Checks/UpdateInfo.cs:17,41,66-73` (thumbprint/checksum parsed from manifest); `mRemoteNG/App/Info/UpdateChannelInfo.cs:68-72` + `mRemoteNG/Properties/OptionsUpdatesPage.settings:11-13` (`UpdateAddress=https://mremoteng.org/`) and `:33-35` (`CheckForUpdatesOnStartup=True` default); `mRemoteNG/UI/Window/UpdateWindow.cs:88-89` (`btnDownload_Click` is user-initiated); `mRemoteNG/App/Shutdown.cs:123-127` (`Process.Start` executes the downloaded installer automatically at app quit, after `PathValidator.ValidateExecutablePathOrThrow`). |
